# Claude Code

> > Official documentation for Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic coding assistant for terminal, IDE, and browser environments.

Claude Code is an AI-powered development tool that integrates with VS Code, GitHub, Slack, and CI/CD pipelines. It supports multiple deployment options including Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and programmatic execution via the Agent SDK.

## Key Topics

- Claude Code
- Anthropic
- VS Code integration
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- GitHub Actions
- Slack integration
- Amazon Bedrock
- Google Vertex AI
- Agent SDK
- CLI usage
- Desktop app
- Workflow automation
- Dev containers
- CI/CD integration
- Browser automation

## Getting Started

- [Claude Code Overview](https://code.claude.com/docs): Introduction to Claude Code's agentic coding capabilities across terminal, IDE, and browser
- [Quickstart Guide](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/quickstart): Fast installation and setup for CLI and IDE environments
- [Desktop Application](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/desktop): Using the desktop app with sessions, diffs, previews, and integrations

## Integrations & Extensions

- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/mcp): Connect external tools and services via MCP integration
- [Plugin Marketplace](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/discover-plugins): Discover and install pre-built plugins and MCP servers
- [Slack Integration](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/slack): Delegate coding tasks from Slack workspace channels
- [Chrome Browser (Beta)](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/chrome): Web testing and browser automation with Chrome integration

## CI/CD & Automation

- [GitHub Actions](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/github-actions): AI-powered workflow automation with GitHub Actions
- [GitLab CI/CD](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/gitlab-ci-cd): Automated merge requests and CI/CD with GitLab
- [Workflow Hooks](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/hooks-guide): Automate workflows with shell command hooks on file events
- [Programmatic Execution](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/headless): Run Claude Code via Agent SDK with Python, TypeScript, or CLI

## Cloud Platforms & Deployment

- [Amazon Bedrock](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/amazon-bedrock): Setup with AWS credentials and IAM configuration
- [Google Vertex AI](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/google-vertex-ai): Configure with Google Cloud IAM and authentication
- [Development Containers](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/devcontainer): Consistent development environments with Docker and VS Code

## Configuration & Customization

- [Output Styles](https://code.claude.com/docs/de/output-styles): Customize output formats and system prompts for various use cases
